note: Catalog of PSI combustion investigations named in the 2026 challenge statement. Every 'quote' is checked word for word against data/sources/CHALLENGE.txt or PSI-26-page.txt. 'in_atlas' = its records are in Flame Atlas.

investigations.name: BASS
investigations.quote: Flammability studies focus on solid materials such as fabrics and plastics, as studied in the Burning and Suppression of Solids (BASS and BASS-II)

investigations.name: BASS-II
investigations.quote: Flammability studies focus on solid materials such as fabrics and plastics, as studied in the Burning and Suppression of Solids (BASS and BASS-II)

investigations.name: Saffire-I, -II, -III
investigations.quote: Spacecraft Fire Safety Demonstration (Saffire-I, -II, and -III) investigations

investigations.name: SAME / SAME-R
investigations.quote: Fire detection was tested in microgravity through the Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment studies (SAME and SAME-R).

investigations.name: FLEX
investigations.quote: Suppression was studied in the Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) through dilution of the chamber atmosphere with carbon dioxide and helium

investigations.name: ACME CFI-G
investigations.quote: Microgravity tests with the highest oxygen concentrations were conducted as part of the ACME's Cool Flames Investigation with Gases (CFI-G).

investigations.name: ACME BRE
investigations.quote: was a study of materials flammability in still atmospheres as a function of material properties.

investigations.name: ACME E-FIELD Flames
investigations.quote: Partial gravity was mimicked in ACME's Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames (E-FIELD Flames) experiment

investigations.name: FLEX-2 / CFI
investigations.quote: FLEX, FLEX-2, and the Cool Flames Investigation (CFI) each featured burning droplets of liquid fuel

investigations.name: SPICE / SLICE
investigations.quote: BASS, BASS-II, the Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment (SPICE), and the Structure & Liftoff In Combustion Experiment (SLICE) collectively featured both solid and gaseous fuels.
